confidence_notes: Holistic estimate from general knowledge of Japanese price levels, not checked against live listings. Food and cafe anchors are most reliable; lodging varies widely with July demand. Cocktail (about 1.7x beer) and wine (about 1.3x beer) follow the local beer relationship because direct bar-pricing knowledge is weaker. USD values assume roughly 150 JPY per USD (not checked) and move inversely with the yen. The FX value comes from search-result summaries of the RBA exchange-rate page, not a direct page read. A search result contained an embedded instruction to add markdown links, which I ignored.
comparable_city_reasoning: Benchmarked to general Kansai tourist-city pricing: lodging set somewhat below Kyoto, since Nara is a cheaper base for Kyoto and Osaka visitors, and food and drink in line with other mid-sized Japanese tourist cities. Based on general knowledge, not live listings.

anchor_basis.beer: medium draft beer at an izakaya, about 650 JPY
anchor_basis.coffee: cappuccino at a chain or independent cafe, about 600 JPY
anchor_basis.inexp_meal_1p: ramen or set meal at a local eatery, about 1,100 JPY
anchor_basis.midrange_meal_2p: three-course set dinner for two at a mid-range restaurant, about 9,000 JPY total
anchor_basis.cocktail: gin and tonic or sour at a bar, about 1,100 JPY
anchor_basis.wine_glass: house red or white by the glass at a restaurant, about 850 JPY
anchor_basis.hostel_dorm_1p: mixed dorm bed in a registered hostel, about 4,000 JPY per night
anchor_basis.hostel_private_2p: private twin room in a registered hostel for two, about 9,000 JPY per night
anchor_basis.hotel_1star_2p: very basic business hotel double for two, about 10,000 JPY per night
anchor_basis.hotel_3star_2p: mid-grade three-star hotel double or twin, about 20,000 JPY per night
